history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V7 decision and adds the owned static-module/dynamic-import graph as a cold-lifecycle capability family. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves modules_dynamic_import from deferred to an implemented zig-js cold-lifecycle capability family. The system JSC public runner must reject the exact module-syntax probe before JSC is reported as N/A; its installed public SDK headers expose script evaluation but no module-loader entry point.

implemented_families_append.surface: cold context creation, host resolution, static module graph load/link/evaluation, top-level await of dynamic import, microtask settlement, checksum read, context teardown, and OS-thread join

JavaScriptCore.result: N/A: system JSC public JSGlobalContext exposes script evaluation but no public module-loader API

availability.public_api_inventory: The installed JavaScriptCore SDK JavaScriptCore.h/JSContext.h/JSContextRef.h inventory contains JSEvaluateScript and Objective-C evaluateScript:, with no public module evaluation or host-loader entry point.

implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: The variant uses a separately named graph, reversed data layout and traversal, different bindings, and reversed static-import order while preserving the exact transform, input multiset, dynamic-import boundary, work, and checksum.
